note: India (Nifty 100) paper-trading ledger. Same repo-published-JSON pattern as portfolios.json, but no FX conversion anywhere -- prices are already INR, real NSE data, tradeable via a normal Indian demat account (unlike the US watchlist's LRS-constrained situation). Checked hourly during NSE market hours (9:15 AM-3:30 PM IST) by a scheduled routine, not continuously -- see CLAUDE.md's India module section for why hourly is the achievable ceiling, not a design choice.

discovered_in.description: Always follows whatever strategy_search_in.json's automated out-of-sample search currently ranks as its best validated combination (fit on ~70% of history, confirmed still profitable on the ~30% it never trained on). Replaced whenever the search finds something better. A live forward-test of a combination that has already cleared one honesty check, not just the flashiest training number.
